content.title: <RichColor Color="0.75,0.02,0.02,1">Welcome to Khaos Nexus</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Welcome to the Khaos Nexus ARK: Survival Ascended cluster.

Current server: Khaos Nexus (Gen1) - Genesis Part 1.

Khaos Nexus is built around long-term progression, quality-of-life improvements, community events, custom rewards, and a growing connected cluster.

Survive. Build. Conquer. Create chaos responsibly.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.75,0.02,0.02,1">Server Information</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>The Nexus ARK environment is designed to reduce unnecessary grind while preserving meaningful progression.

The server uses a curated quality-of-life mod stack for storage, breeding, transport, crafting, building, dino utility, and shop features.

Major balance changes, maintenance, and map additions are announced through Khaos Nexus.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.75,0.02,0.02,1">Community Rules</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>1. Respect players and staff.

2. No cheating, meshing, duping, exploit abuse, or knowingly using bugs for an unfair advantage.

3. Do not intentionally cause server instability or excessive performance problems.

4. Do not impersonate staff.

5. Follow staff instructions during incidents, events, maintenance, and investigations.

6. Report serious bugs and exploits instead of spreading or abusing them.

7. Use Nexus support for disputes and server issues when possible.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.75,0.02,0.02,1">Nexus Shop</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Khaos Nexus uses the MX-E Ark Shop UI in-game. The ASA ArkShop backend and Nexus Sentinel integration are being brought online.

Once active, points, kits, rewards, and listings will be managed centrally across Nexus maps.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.75,0.02,0.02,1">Connected Nexus</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Genesis Part 1 is the first active Khaos Nexus map. Additional maps will be added as the community and infrastructure grow.

Permissions, shop data, status, events, administration, and player-facing information are being designed as cluster-wide services.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.75,0.02,0.02,1">Khaos Nexus Community</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Expect community events, boss runs, challenges, boosted periods, special rewards, and other Nexus activities.

Nexus Sentinel is being developed to coordinate status, administration, shop systems, configuration, events, Discord integration, and cross-map services.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.75,0.02,0.02,1">Need Help?</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>If you encounter a server problem, missing item, mod issue, transfer problem, suspected exploit, or need staff assistance, contact Khaos Nexus staff through the Discord support system.

Include the map, character or tribe name, approximate time, what happened, and screenshots or video when available.</>
